## Summary

Describe the user-visible and technical changes.

## Privacy and safety

- [ ] Data flow and permissions are unchanged, or the relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] No credentials, real contact datasets, or private profile content are included.
- [ ] Explicit consent and human review remain intact.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e`
- [ ] Manual extension smoke test, when UI or Chrome behavior changed
